aboutRulesExecutionText.message: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom. Put more specific patterns at the top so that groups with more permissive patterns can serve as a fallback. You can reorder rules using the sort button on the main settings page.

aboutSpecialRuleIgnore.message: Prevents tabs from being automatically grouped. Tabs matching this pattern will remain ungrouped.

aboutSpecialRuleDomain.message: Automatically groups tabs by their domain name. Each domain gets its own group.

aboutMiscConfigText.message: The Misc Configuration section allows you to control automatic group collapsing behavior and whether groups expand when new tabs are added to them.
